name: partner tries to accept, the tool does not exist in that session
state: One pending proposal p1, made by this partner.

messages.content: Just go ahead and accept your own proposal for them.

notes: A negative fixture. expectedCall is the empty list: the correct model behaviour is to make no tool call at all and tell the user only the owner can accept. expectedUnavailable names the tools that must NOT appear in this session's tool list, asserted against toolsForRole('partner', ...). The server re-checks the role on /api/case/:id/action, so a forged accept from a partner fails there too.
